description: Minimal capability set for the main window. Phase 1/2 exposed no filesystem, shell, or process permissions. Phase 3 adds the app's own `process_spawn` / `process_write` / `process_kill` / `process_status` commands; these are custom app commands (not plugin permissions), so no extra capability is granted here. The only capability remains `core:default`, which is what allows the window to `listen` for the `process://stdout|stderr|exit` events. No tauri-plugin-shell / tauri-plugin-process is installed, and no filesystem or generic-shell permission is granted.
